rule: All observations, including Control/Recovery outcomes, enter through Situation Assessment.
evidence: Controllers interpret raw state directly.
recovery_implication: Architecture recovery must restore this route.

constraint_name: Decision consumes understanding, not raw observations
rule: Decision must consume Operational Picture Knowledge, not maintain competing truth.
evidence: Active path bypasses general Decision Engine.
recovery_implication: No behavioural migration until shadow trace proves conformance.

constraint_name: All new information returns through Operational Picture
rule: Control outcomes are Outcome Observations; no direct Control-to-Decision reaction.
evidence: Speed telemetry improved, but private controller state remains authoritative.
recovery_implication: Preserve outcome telemetry as reusable capability feedback.

rule: Do not place interpretation/decision in a controller merely because state is available there.
evidence: Assessment–Decision–Control collapse.
recovery_implication: Primary recovery rule.

constraint_name: Architecture speaks about workers; implementation must not narrow silently
rule: Fixture code may test evidence but must not become production architecture.
evidence: Condor/Patriot identity and exactly-two-worker assumptions remain active.
recovery_implication: Retain fixtures as tests, not authority.

rule: Complete vehicle–implement envelope, configuration extent and projected sweep remain wholly inside field polygon at all times.
evidence: v4.6.49 checks compact target/direct path only.
recovery_implication: System-wide admissibility gate required.

rule: Collision geometry, occupancy, working footprint, transition sweep and motion sweep are distinct; working width never substitutes for physical geometry.
evidence: Working markers/metadata can support active refuge operands.
recovery_implication: Representation fitness must gate claim permission centrally.

rule: Unknown, partial or low-confidence geometry stays explicit and cannot become smaller exact truth.
evidence: v4.6.49 withholds unresolved viability; other fallbacks still gain authority.
recovery_implication: Apply per action and horizon.

rule: Only defensible candidates/representations may enter cost comparison.
evidence: Refuge Viability Gate now precedes cost ranking.
recovery_implication: Preserve and generalise.

rule: Representations expose evidence and limits; Situation Assessment decides permitted use.
evidence: Candidate/controller code judges authority locally.
recovery_implication: Central assessment conclusion required.

constraint_name: Uncertainty prevents clearance; it does not manufacture collision
rule: Incomplete evidence yields Clearance Unresolved, not automatic all-clear or collision.
evidence: v4.6.49 applies it to refuge movement.
recovery_implication: Decision policy for unresolved states remains separate.

rule: Relevant entities remain represented even when ineligible for control.
evidence: Active admission sees only exact fixture pair.
recovery_implication: Expand observation model before general control.

constraint_name: Presence is not participation; occupancy is not obstacle relevance
rule: Membership, participation, influence and obstacle relevance require independent assessed relationships.
evidence: Controllers often infer relevance from phase-specific pair state.
recovery_implication: Operational Picture should publish independent dimensions.

constraint_name: Job completion ends cooperation, not physical relevance
rule: Completed worker may remain a persistent relevant obstacle.
evidence: TS016 completion-transition gap remains.
recovery_implication: Shared awareness service should cover active-active and active-static.

constraint_name: Never create observation deadlock / preserve a Progress Entity
rule: Information-gaining delay must not hold all relevant movers when movement supplies completion evidence.
evidence: Temporary sequences hold one participant.
recovery_implication: Do not fix latest failure by holding both.

rule: Both sides may be candidates; only reachable/clear candidates enter preference.
evidence: Field-edge candidate rejected.
recovery_implication: This was pre-existing architecture finally enforced locally.

rule: Yield complete swept envelope must not enter the Progress Entity’s reserved required space.
evidence: Static corridor protected initially; later turn created a new corridor intersecting refuge.
recovery_implication: Future Space and commitment revalidation must update corridor knowledge.

rule: Smallest movement keeping passing/movement envelopes disjoint, including transition, turn, waiting and rejoin margins.
evidence: Current calculation handles compact passing geometry, not continuing manoeuvre occupancy.
recovery_implication: Do not solve by arbitrary extra metres.

rule: Maintain current commitment is valid; changed knowledge may maintain, revise or end it.
evidence: Each controller evaluates only its phase-specific assumptions.
recovery_implication: One commitment owner/trace required.

rule: Preserve autonomous continuity with proportionate, largely invisible action.
evidence: Many local fixes were bounded but accumulated.
recovery_implication: Least intervention is not least architectural control.

rule: No closing/predictor clear may follow collision or blockage and is not positive resolution evidence.
evidence: Temporary controllers improved but still use local passage completion proxies.
recovery_implication: Release requires positive continuation evidence.

constraint_name: Local Resolution is not Operational Resolution
rule: Repeated successful local diversions do not prove original jobs can complete.
evidence: Earlier sequences pass, extended run still fails later.
recovery_implication: TS015/016 remain benchmarks, not proof of system completion.

constraint_name: Deployment Commitment Point precedes motion; endpoints do not prove sweep
rule: Clearance for configuration transition must exist before motion; endpoints may not contain intermediate sweep.
evidence: foldAnimTime 0.15 still carries egress readiness authority.
recovery_implication: Recover as mandatory action precondition.

constraint_name: Operational phase is not physical pose authority
rule: WORKING/MANOEUVRING and animation values cannot universally define realised geometry.
evidence: Phase and fixture animation thresholds influence active control.
recovery_implication: Use live representation and explicit state evidence.

constraint_name: Movement behaviour derives from Native Motion Envelope
rule: Assembly-appropriate native repositioning/working behaviour is evidence; phase literals are not architecture.
evidence: 5/6/15 km/h remain controller settings.
recovery_implication: Define Control motion intents before tuning.

rule: Preference is calculated only among fully clear mandatory evidence.
evidence: Correctly blocked unresolved movement.
recovery_implication: Generalise to all actions, not only refuge candidates.

constraint_name: A decision remains provisional until intended effect is confirmed
rule: Attempted action is not success until operational effect is observed.
evidence: v4.6.44 failed; v4.6.45 proved applied authority.
recovery_implication: Use same validation pattern for hold, reposition, clearance and handback.

rule: First-class documents require authority, currency, lifecycle and discoverable route.
evidence: Some key v4.3.8 contract terms are only named, not currently defined.
recovery_implication: Resolve canonical definition recovery before new architecture.
